text:
Seth Jarvis has played only 8 of Carolina's 19 games, joining the lineup on October 22, and he's picked up 8 points in them, with assists in three of four games during one stretch. His goals match his chances almost exactly (2 on 2.1 expected), and Carolina gets 60% of the expected goals at five on five with him on.

Eight games is a small sample, and his ice time is down to about 16 minutes a night, more than two and a half minutes below what he was getting. The point pace, 3.68 per 60 minutes, sits above our range for him, so expect some cooling there.

The longer record is strong. Evolving-Hockey had him 42nd of 401 forwards last season, a two-win player who draws more penalties than he takes, with the caveat that Carolina's strong teammates flatter everyone's raw numbers. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking puts his home-plate chances in the 86th percentile and shows him on the end of plenty of royal-road passes. He scored 32 goals last season. Watch his minutes: if they climb back toward 18, the goals will follow.
headline: Seth Jarvis is back and feeding the machine
